q: Which harness part turns a policy such as “never run rm -rf” into a guarantee rather than a request?
options: A sandbox, permission rule or fail-closed hook enforced in code
explain: Prompts ask; sandboxes, permissions and hooks that block on failure enforce. A hook that crashes or times out can fail open.

q: What does progressive disclosure mean for skills?
options: Skills are shown to users gradually
Only a skill’s name and description load by default; its body loads when relevant
Skills are disabled until paid for
explain: It keeps many skills available at almost no context cost.

q: Why can the same model score very differently in two harnesses?
options: Tools, prompts, budgets and context management differ, and they affect results as much as the model
explain: Model plus harness equals product; always report both.
